name: geodata-kit-repo
description: Monorepo for geodata-kit: countries, subdivisions, cities, languages, timezones, address and phone data built from GeoNames, CLDR, IANA tzdata, Wikidata, Natural Earth and libphonenumber.

scripts.build: npm run emit && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.python:test: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.release:version: changeset version && tsx scripts/release/sync-versions.ts && npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund
